cards.title: Moon Muffin Market Final Copy Card
cards.finalCopySkill: copy one fictional moon-market story draft into a clean final notebook page with an opening, neat lines, kept details, sentence boundaries, dialogue marks, and a final paper check
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only spiral notebook final-copy card for copying one fictional Moon Muffin Market story draft onto a clean page: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set a draft page, a clean spiral notebook page, and this card on the table before the writer copies the moon-market story offline on paper: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: copy the pretend moon-market story offline onto the clean paper-only notebook page, moving slowly enough to keep each sentence easy to read: ____________________.
cards.openingCopyPrompt: Opening copy: copy the first sentence so the reader meets the market helper and the moonlit stall right away: ____________________.
cards.neatCopyPrompt: Neat copy: leave a small space between words and keep each notebook line calm from left to right: ____________________.
cards.detailTransferPrompt: Detail transfer: bring over two helpful details from the draft, such as the silver awning, crumb map, or bell tag: ____________________.
cards.sentenceBoundaryPrompt: Sentence boundary: check each sentence for a starting capital and an ending mark before copying the next one: ____________________.
cards.dialogueCopyPrompt: Dialogue copy: if a made-up helper speaks, copy the talking words inside quotation marks and add who says them: ____________________.
cards.finalCopyCheckPrompt: Final copy check: reread the notebook page and mark one place where the final copy is clear enough to keep: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult points to one sentence, and the writer copies only that sentence onto the clean offline paper page: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: copy another short pretend moon-market draft onto spiral notebook paper with one opening, two details, and clean sentence ends: ____________________.
